Daily practices for deeper presence and calm
Bring focus into daily life: Get gentle micro-prompts to remain present and relaxed during mundane actions like walking, drinking water, or resting.
Shared focus space: Realize you are not alone. Send or receive silent waves of calm energy to synchronize with others focused right now.
%1$s focusers are currently in Flow worldwide. Pulse in unity.
Tap anywhere to emit a wave of calm focus
Decongest the busy mind: Practice paced breathing to trigger Heart Rate Variability (HRV) coherence and explore gentle awareness pointers.

Breathing slowly at a rate of 6 seconds in and 6 seconds out synchronizes your heart rate with respiration. This reduces stress, lowers cortisol, and naturally quietens the brain\'s analytical networks, guiding you into a deeply peaceful state of flow.
A 1-minute guided exploration to quiet the analytical mind.
Take a slow, deep breath. Observe the visual space of this screen.
Notice if there is any tension in your shoulders or face, and let it soften.
Let go of the need to do or achieve anything for just a moment.
Observe: who is the one noticing these thoughts right now?
Rest in this quiet, open space of awareness where thoughts come and go.
You are here, perfectly present. Stillness in action.
Feel the ground beneath your feet. Feel the support.
Take one conscious breath. Notice the cool air entering your nostrils.
Soften your shoulders. Release any hidden tension in your jaw.
Listen closely to the nearest sound. Then listen to the farthest sound.
Notice the spaces between your thoughts. Find the stillness there.
Observe the weight of your hands resting in your lap.
Gaze gently at an object near you. Appreciate its simple existence without naming it.
Touch your chest. Feel the constant, quiet rhythm of your heart.
